Using JohnCRM

Conversations & webchat

Reply to customers, take over from AI, and connect your website to the same workspace.

On this page
Choose the right inboxReply to a customerWork alongside AIAdd chat to your websiteTest the conversation

Choose the right inbox

  • Internal Chat brings together conversations with known customers. WhatsApp (QR Code) and WhatsApp Business API are the available WhatsApp connections; channels marked Coming Soon are not ready to connect.
  • External Chat receives messages from website visitors. Visitors can start without signing in or providing a name or email.
  • Create client in a visitor conversation turns that visitor into a customer record and moves the thread into Internal Chat. The visitor’s website session continues.

Reply to a customer

  1. 1Select a conversation and read the recent messages. Check the customer and channel before sending.
  2. 2Write your reply. On desktop, Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. On touch devices, use the Send button.
  3. 3In Internal Chat, use the paperclip to add supported files and wait for uploads to finish. Check delivery status after sending; use Retry when a message fails.
Website chat attachments

Visitors can send images and PDFs. Agents currently send text replies through External Chat; sending attachments back to visitors is not supported.

Work alongside AI

A pending AI reply shows a countdown and controls to Edit, Send now or Hold. Hold pauses the reply so you can take over. By default, replying yourself pauses AI on that conversation; a manual reply always pauses AI in website chat.

  • Limited replies when confident, asks for clarification when unsure, and hands sensitive conversations to a person. Full allows a broader range of AI replies. Off leaves the conversation with a person.
  • Use Resume AI in the paused conversation banner when you are ready. If the mode is Off, first choose Limited or Full.
  • Open Notifications to find conversations that need attention. Follow the linked message and review the customer’s request before responding.

Add chat to your website

  1. 1Open Configurations → External Chat and enable website chat with an account that can manage workspace settings.
  2. 2Set the chatbot name, greeting, colour and theme. Add a launcher icon or chatbot profile image if needed.
  3. 3Copy the embed snippet provided by your workspace and add it to your website’s HTML or custom-code area. Publish the website change.
HTML
<script
  src="https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/widget/chat.js"
  data-site-key="YOUR_SITE_KEY"
  async
></script>

This example shows the shape of the snippet. Use the app domain and site key from your own copied snippet. Rotating the site key invalidates the old snippet, so update every website using it.

Test the conversation

  1. 1Open the published website in a private browser window, open chat, and send a simple question about your business.
  2. 2Find the visitor in External Chat. Check the AI answer against your knowledge, then send a manual reply and confirm it arrives on the website.
The widget is missing or a reply cannot send

Confirm the widget is enabled, the published snippet uses the current site key, and your website allows the script to load. If allowed origins were configured, the website origin must match; John can help check that setting.

A closed visitor chat disables sending to that session. For WhatsApp Business API, free-form replies require the customer to have messaged within the last 24 hours. Read the error before retrying.
